Course overview

Know what you’re preparing for.

GP Rating is an entry route toward deck and engine rating work on merchant vessels. National Global Academy’s preparation support helps students understand the pathway, build foundational knowledge and evaluate recognised pre-sea training options. Certification and sea-time arrangements must always be verified directly with the relevant approved institution.

Who this is for

  • Students who have completed Class 10 and want a technical sea-career route
  • Applicants who prefer hands-on deck or engine work over guest service
  • Students who meet applicable age, academic and medical criteria
  • Families comparing recognised GP Rating institutions and full costs

Career outcomes & reality

Prepare for a pathway—not a promise.

Your next role depends on eligibility, recognised training where required, performance, documents and employer vacancies.

Possible directions

  • Apply for recognised GP Rating pre-sea training when eligible
  • Pursue deck or engine rating opportunities after required certification and selection
  • Build sea service toward further certification under applicable rules
  • Develop transferable safety, maintenance and teamwork skills
Indicative industry ranges

What can you earn?

New rating/trainee earnings are commonly discussed around ₹20,000–₹60,000 per month during onboard engagement, varying by company, vessel and experience. These are indicative industry ranges, not an assurance of a job or income. Ask about waiting periods and whether between-contract time is unpaid.

Read: GP Rating Course: Fees, Eligibility & Career Scope
For parents

Make the decision together, with the full picture.

GP Rating advertisements can be confusing. Before paying, verify who provides the recognised course and certificate, whether the quoted amount includes medicals and boarding, and how recruitment actually works. Do not pay any individual for a promised ship joining.

Straight answers

GP Rating: your questions, answered.

Eligibility, cost, safety and what happens next.

What is GP Rating course eligibility?

It generally involves Class 10 education plus age, academic and medical requirements. Exact marks, vision and age criteria must be checked against current DG Shipping guidelines and the recognised institution’s rules.

What are GP Rating course fees?

[CONFIRM: Insert current National Global Academy fee and clearly separate external institution, hostel, medical and document charges.] Ask for a dated, signed cost sheet and refund policy.

Can girls apply for GP Rating?

Women can pursue maritime careers where current course and employer criteria are met. Families should verify training facilities, onboard policies and employer support systems directly.

What happens after GP Rating?

After required recognised training and certification, candidates can seek suitable rating opportunities. Employment is not automatic; document readiness, selection and vacancies matter. Further progression requires applicable sea service and certification.
